set.approach: The parking lot sits at the north end of the cliff in Franconia Notch and can only be entered from the southbound side of the highway. A long talus slope leads up to the base of the cliff; it is awkward when wet or snow-covered, and rockfall is common below the face. The route starts up a dike-like streak just right of the VMC route and left of the Direct Direct.

review.notes: Cannon area page: parking and talus approach. Route page: location of the start.
